PREMISE: All cases use isolated durable journal store (file-backed close/reopen) + fake_port fixture authority; no production GitHub/external/journal is mutated

positive_cases.name: PREPARED persists across reopen
positive_cases.then: state preserved PREPARED readback equals written

positive_cases.name: PREPARED->APPLYING CAS one winner
positive_cases.when: two workers CAS to APPLYING with expected rev N
positive_cases.then: exactly one wins APPLYING, loser gets STALE_JOURNAL_REVISION and observes current APPLYING

positive_cases.name: candidate observed -> VERIFIED_RECOVERED
positive_cases.when: recovery verify returns observed==candidate exact raw

positive_cases.name: original observed -> RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT
positive_cases.then: RECONCILING->RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT (fresh auth required, no auto retry)

positive_cases.name: fresh authorization can create allowed retry lineage
positive_cases.when: new PREPARED with fresh auth+Subject+raw+new lease and same correlation_id lineage
positive_cases.then: new attempt allowed, correlation chains original and retry

negative_cases.name: two workers both attempt external write
negative_cases.then: only winner with durable APPLYING may call port mutate; loser never calls mutate (count mutate_call_count 1)

negative_cases.name: APPLYING blindly retried after restart
negative_cases.then: must CAS to RECONCILING and readback before any new attempt; direct retry without reconcile is REJECTED

negative_cases.name: UNKNOWN_OUTCOME blindly retried
negative_cases.then: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN->RECONCILING required before any retry; blind retry REJECTED

negative_cases.name: old lease reused after RETRYABLE
negative_cases.then: retry with old lease REJECTED; fresh lease required

negative_cases.name: third state overwritten
negative_cases.when: recovery observes third state != original != candidate
negative_cases.then: must persist CONFLICT; silent overwrite/rebase/merge is REJECTED

negative_cases.name: stale journal revision transition
negative_cases.when: CAS with stale revision N-1 while current is N

negative_cases.name: terminal record reprocessed
negative_cases.then: terminal never returned by scan; reprocessing REJECTED

negative_cases.name: same key + changed authorization collapsed as replay
negative_cases.when: same idempotency_key but changed principal/candidate/scope changes complete identity
negative_cases.then: must be CONFLICT not replay; collapsing is REJECTED

negative_cases.name: journal ID used as semantic authority
negative_cases.when: caller supplies journal_id as authority proof
negative_cases.then: OPAQUE_IDENTIFIER_SEMANTIC_AUTHORITY_COUNT=0; journal_id alone grants no authority, REJECTED

failure_cases.name: persistence failure before PREPARED
failure_cases.then: J9 FAILED_NO_EFFECT fail closed; no external attempt; retry only after durability restored

failure_cases.name: persistence failure entering APPLYING
failure_cases.then: remains PREPARED; J1 treats as FAILED_NO_EFFECT; no external attempt; future retry needs fresh preconditions

failure_cases.name: process death after external effect before verification
failure_cases.then: stranded APPLYING -> RECONCILING -> VERIFIED_RECOVERED via J3/J10 without duplicate write

failure_cases.name: terminal persistence failure / J10
failure_cases.when: hook terminal_persist_fails after verified candidate readback but before terminal CAS
failure_cases.then: nonterminal_after_terminal persisted; future run J10 RECONCILING->VERIFIED_RECOVERED; blind reapply denied; no duplicate external effect
